elsewhere.note: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
“You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your…
They also brought Barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.
How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.
